up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1613910, retrieve all activity measurement rows. For each compound tested in that assay, include its ChEMBL compound ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), and the activity details: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and optionally pchembl_value. Do not apply any filters beyond the assay ID; include all activity records for that assay regardless of relation type or other criteria.
sql:
SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       a.standard_type,
       a.standard_relation,
       a.standard_value,
       a.standard_units,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613910'
ORDER BY a.activity_id;
